claim.unit: model calls to replay a test
claim.footnote: *Android checkout test, Nov 22. Learning it took 13 model calls on Kimi K3.1 Pro on Cerebras.

intro.title: Déjà
intro.description: AI testing agents call the model on every run, even when nothing changed. Déjà lets the agent learn a test once, then replay it with no model. Formerly WalkCache.
